This smartphone UI screen is from an app titled "Dog Sounds." The screen is currently displaying the "ACTIONS" category, as indicated by the highlighted tab at the top. The main content consists of a grid of images, each representing a different dog sound. There are six dog sounds displayed:

1. Angry - Image of a dog appearing to bark.
2. Distant - Image of a dog in the distance.
3. Panting - Image of a dog panting.
4. Sniffing - Close-up image of a dog sniffing.
5. Snoring - Image of a dog that appears to be snoring.
6. Sniffing 2 - Another image of a dog sniffing.

At the top of the screen, there are additional tabs for other categories of dog sounds: "BARKING," "WHINING," and "HOWLING." There are also icons for settings and sharing options in the top right corner.
